title: Can I BEAT King of the Bridge? (Good Ending)
summary: King of the Bridge (pixel-art troll chess game) 'Good Ending' run: defeat the cheating Troll WITHOUT using any revenge/payback cheats. Troll dialogue e.g. 'I feel like we are really getting to know eachother!'; thumbnail shows the Troll with a halo.
rules: Base King of the Bridge rules (see WEYUcaJTBso): Troll's rule book, Space to accuse a cheat; correct accusation lets you cheat once (do not use it for this ending).
Rule 11: when the black king dies the crown passes to another black piece.
Good Ending condition: win without using any revenge cheats.
win_condition: Defeat the Troll with zero revenge cheats used.
